issues.description: Q3: ② 'it' vs 'them'. 'operations' is plural, so 'without thinking about them' is correct and 'it' is wrong. This is clear. However, some students might argue 'the whole concept' (singular) could be referred to by 'it'. In standard grammar, the antecedent 'operations' is plural → 'them' required. Error is clear.

Q16 wa='extending the number of operations we can perform without thinking' — stem says (10단어). Count: extending(1) the(2) number(3) of(4) operations(5) we(6) can(7) perform(8) without(9) thinking(10) = 10단어. Verified correct.
Q18 wa='produced just as much customer response as' — stem says (7단어). Count: produced(1) just(2) as(3) much(4) customer(5) response(6) as(7) = 7단어. Verified correct.

Q19: [조건] coupons / discount / do / double / duty / expect / to (7단어). wa='expect discount coupons to do double duty'. Count: expect(1) discount(2) coupons(3) to(4) do(5) double(6) duty(7) = 7단어. All condition tokens used. Passage blank: 'we _____'. Full sentence: 'we expect discount coupons to do double duty'. Verified correct.
